title: Airwallex footer
description: A cool-grey sitemap footer: a large bold wordmark with two dark app-store pills opposite, ten link groups in a five-by-two grid (two columns on phones), a hairline, the copyright with small social icons, and two lines of fine-print legal text. Links turn violet on hover.
notes: groups come in reading order: on desktop they fill rows of five; on phones the first half forms the left column and the rest the right
the store pills are plain text buttons (no store logos)
